name: InputGroup
purpose: Frame around a single input with a leading icon slot: the search well in the task list. Also (text): The one chrome for text entry (shadcn InputGroup): a bordered or filled well that holds one Input plus addons. Draws the border, fill and focus ring; a press anywhere in the well focuses the Input. Two tones: field (bordered sheet well) and search (filled grey pill with no border). Merged from A's InputWell and B's InputGroup. Kept the search tone (catalogue lines 16 and 60 describe the grey pill), because the missing border is felt. Heights at 1rem=14px: md h-10 = 35px (matches the measured 345x35 sheet well); sm h-7 = 24.5px (measured 25px). The trailing slot holds the clear button and the dice roll button. Covers the sheet field well and the sheet name with a fixed suffix. Sources: A (InputWell, sheet well h-10) and B (InputGroup).

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon in the leading slot (A's addon leading-icon).

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the well. Owning widget (SearchField, sheet) sets it and the Input inherits it.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Locked, greyed, non-editable tail at the end of the well. The caller appends it to the trimmed value on accept (sheet name with fixed suffix). A's TextField carried this prop; moved here because it is well chrome.

props.name: focusInputOnPress
props.description: Default true. A press anywhere in the well focuses the inner Input.

role: none on the wrapper; the inner input supplies the role (textbox, searchbox or combobox)
keyboard: None on the frame; focus goes to the inner field. / None on the well. Tab reaches the inner Input; trailing buttons are separate tab stops after it. A press anywhere in the well focuses the Input (focusInputOnPress).
